g.text: Orientation of the frozen Q/V update matters on selected prefixes
Same 10 previously rescued prefixes in every condition. B-coordinate permutations preserve update norms.
This endpoint measures the next token at a fixed prefix. The restored overlay reproduced every archived logit vector.
